submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one native high-resolution transparent game run sprite, east direction frame 03.
Image 1 is the exact edit target and defines the canvas registration, body/head scale, direction, feet and leg pose. Image 2 is character identity only. Image 3 is the approved polished bright Daoist Q-style rendering reference, not a layout to copy.
Keep the feet, knees, boots, pelvis, torso, head, hair and camera in Image 1 unchanged. Her anatomical RIGHT arm is the visible near arm connected to the silver-blue near shoulder ornament. It must still hold the single blue crystal sword. Her LEFT arm remains the far arm holding one blue talisman.
Change only the right arm/wrist and sword into an intermediate relaxed running swing: the right hand moves slightly forward/down to the side of the hip, approximately x690 y810 on this same 1254 square canvas. Visible continuous shoulder-to-elbow-to-hand chain. The straight sword is now pointing diagonally UP-LEFT, with its tip approximately x420 y440, beside/over the trailing hair but clear of the face. Its hilt stays in that near right hand, one complete sword, same size and design. This is a running hand transition, not an attack.
Do not change the support feet, head position, body proportions, costume, lighting, transparent canvas size, margins, or pose registration. Preserve full sole contact of the foreground right boot, knee compression and rear left foot off ground. Do not mirror, swap hands, create a ghost blade/hilt or move the entire figure. Exact same foot heading forward to screen right. Genuine alpha transparency; no ground, shadow, marks or text.
